decisions.reason: It closely extends the firm's established airfield control and monitoring capabilities, and with strong in-house R&D, system-integration know-how and a growing market, the firm is well placed to learn from early deployment and improve it commercially.

It fits the firm's core airport surveillance and integrated-operations knowledge base, so under an absorptive-capacity view the firm can interpret initial market feedback, refine the product through its own R&D and use it to strengthen its broader intelligent airport operations offering.
